h1: Cheapest LMS for Early-Stage Educators (2026): How to Start With the Least Risk
dek: For educators with no students yet: what each LMS costs before and after your first sale, which free trials need no card, and how to launch a first course without paying for a year of software you may not use.
cover_alt: Just starting as an educator: which LMS costs least to begin, free trials and no-upfront-fee plans compared, prices checked 24 Oct 2026
audience: Early-stage educators and tutors in India launching a first online course
intro: For an educator with no sales yet, the lowest-cost way to start is a free trial to build your first course, then a plan that costs little before your first sale. On published prices, Exly Starter and TagMango Basic have no upfront fee and take 10% of each sale, so they cost the least if a checkout page is all you need. But the lowest upfront price is not always the lowest total: once you add your own domain or your own app, those plans add yearly add-ons. AllCoaching is one predictable annual plan from ₹6,999 plus a fee only when you sell, with your own website and Android app (iOS app on Pro) included, and it starts with a 7-day free trial with no card.
We are AllCoaching, so weigh that. Every competitor figure here comes from the company's own pricing page, checked on 24 Oct 2026, and we say plainly where another option costs you less.

This guide is for the first year: one course, a handful of students, and money you would rather not lock away. If you already sell and want to compare value at higher sales, read our guide to the most affordable LMS for independent educators.
takeaways: Start free, then pay: AllCoaching (7 days, no card), Kajabi and Circle (14 days), Thinkific (30 days), Teachable and Edmingle (7 days) let you build before paying.
No upfront fee is not free: Exly Starter and TagMango Basic take 10% of each sale, so ₹1,000 of sales costs ₹100.
On ₹50,000 of first-year sales, Exly Starter costs ₹5,000, AllCoaching Starter ₹11,999, Learnyst Launcher ₹15,000 and Classplus ₹29,999 on published prices, before GST.
Add-ons change the order: Exly's app add-on starts at ₹60,000 a year and TagMango's custom-domain setup at ₹24,999 + GST a year; AllCoaching includes both domain and app.
AllCoaching is one predictable annual plan from ₹6,999 (GST extra) plus 10%, 7.5% or 5% only when you sell.
Your lowest-risk first step is one course and a free demo lesson, shown to ten students before you commit to any plan.

sections.h2: The short answer: start on a trial, then pay as little as possible before your first sale
sections.html:
The cheapest LMS for an early-stage educator is the one that costs the least before you have students and still gives you what you need when they arrive. Pick the row that matches where you are.

{{fig:verdict|Which low-cost LMS to start on: no course yet, start on a free trial; sell with nothing upfront, Exly Starter or TagMango Basic; own website and app from day one, AllCoaching; already teaching on YouTube and WhatsApp, free tools plus a checkout|Where you are today decides the lowest-risk start.}}

The rest of this guide shows the numbers at first-year sales levels and compares the free trials.

sections.h2: How we compared LMS costs for new educators
sections.html:
Early-stage educators carry a different risk from established ones: you do not yet know how many students will pay. So we compared options on what matters in the first year.

  1. Cost before your first sale: the upfront or yearly price, from each official pricing page.
  2. Cost at small sales: ₹25,000 to ₹2 lakh in the first year.
  3. The free trial: how long, and whether a card is needed to start.
  4. What you would have to add later: own domain, own app, taxes.
  5. How easy it is to leave: whether you can take your students and data with you.
Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide. Competitor figures link to their official pages and carry the date we checked them (24 Oct 2026). Prices change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.

sections.h2: What early-stage educators actually risk when choosing an LMS
sections.html:
The biggest risk in your first year is not overpaying by a few thousand rupees. It is paying for a year of software before you know anyone will buy, or building on something you will have to leave once students arrive.

1. Paying before demand exists

A ₹29,999 yearly plan is a large bet when you have not sold a course yet. A trial, a no-upfront-fee plan or a small annual plan keeps that bet small.

2. A low start that gets expensive later

A plan with no upfront fee is the lowest-cost start. But if you later need your own domain or app, add-ons can cost more in a year than a plan that includes them. Check the add-on prices on day one, not after your first batch.

3. Starting on something you will have to leave

Moving students later is work. If you think you will want your own website and app within a year, it is easier to start there than to move a running batch.

{{q:Can I start with only YouTube, WhatsApp and UPI?|Yes, and many educators sell their first batch that way. It costs nothing beyond your phone. It gets hard once you are checking payment screenshots and adding students by hand for 30 or more people, which is usually the moment to move to one platform.}} {{fig:before-after|Before and after for a new educator: lessons as YouTube links, fees by UPI screenshot, notes on WhatsApp and tests on Google Forms, compared with one academy built on a free trial with your own website, app and UPI checkout|Free tools are a fine start for batch one. One login saves the hours when batch two arrives.}}

sections.h2: 8 low-cost ways to launch your first online course
sections.html:
Here are the low-risk ways to start, each described the way its own company describes it, with what it costs before and after your first sale.

Our platform · disclosure

1. AllCoaching

Good at
An academy you build yourself, like Shopify for coaching: sign up, choose a plan, upload your course, connect your domain and start selling. Website on your own domain, your own Android app (iOS app on Pro), courses, tests, unlimited live classes and UPI checkout in one studio.
Before your first sale
7-day free trial with no card needed. After that, Starter is ₹6,999 a year (GST extra).[1]
After your first sale
10% of each sale on Starter; 7.5% on Growth (₹12,999/yr) and 5% on Pro (₹24,999/yr).
Check
At very small sales the ₹6,999 is a large share: on ₹50,000 of first-year sales you pay ₹11,999 in total, about 24%.
Best for
New educators who want their own brand from the first course and can carry ₹6,999 for a year.

2. Exly (Starter)

Good at
Storefront, payments, CRM and WhatsApp and email automation for coaches; it calls itself "an all-in-one solution to all things business".
Before your first sale
No upfront fee: Exly lists the Starter annual fee as "FREE".[2]
After your first sale
10% commission on Starter; Pro ₹30,000/yr + 6% and Premium ₹1,08,000/yr + 3%.
Check
A mobile app (iOS and Android) is an add-on from ₹60,000 a year; GST and a free trial are not stated.
Best for
Selling a first course or sessions from a checkout page with nothing paid upfront.

3. TagMango (Basic)

Good at
Courses, community and automation for coaches, with optional branded apps.
Before your first sale
Basic has no fixed fee.[3]
After your first sale
10% commission, including the Indian payment gateway, + GST; up to 200 students on Basic.
Check
A custom domain needs the "Freedom Setup" at ₹24,999 + GST a year; branded apps are a ₹74,999 + GST setup. A free trial is not stated.
Best for
Community-led coaching where you are happy on TagMango's address at first.

4. Learnyst (Launcher)

Good at
Courses, mock tests and live classes with test series; it pitches "Features required to market and sell your content online across globe".
Before your first sale
Launcher is ₹10,000 a year + taxes ("No monthly fee"); its buttons say "Get started for free", but a trial length is not stated.[4]
After your first sale
10% of sales on Launcher.
Check
What Launcher includes for apps and your own domain.
Best for
A new exam educator whose first product is a test series.

5. Free tools you already use

Good at
YouTube for lessons, WhatsApp for doubts and updates, UPI for fees and Google Forms for tests. Many educators sell their first batch this way.
Before your first sale
Nothing beyond your phone and internet.
After your first sale
No platform fee, but you check every payment, add every student by hand and share links that can be forwarded.
Check
How many hours a week admin takes once you pass 20 or 30 students.
Best for
Testing one idea with your first 10 students.

6. Tutor LMS on WordPress

Good at
A WordPress LMS plugin with a free core and paid Pro add-ons; it supports Razorpay among payment gateways.
Before your first sale
The core plugin is free; Pro Individual is $199 a year for 1 site, excluding taxes, with a 30-day money-back guarantee.[12]
After your first sale
No platform fee is stated; your payment gateway charges apply.
Check
Hosting, a domain, updates, security and any mobile app are separate and are yours to run.
Best for
Educators who already run a WordPress site or have someone who does.

7. Thinkific, Kajabi and Teachable (trials in US dollars)

Good at
International course platforms with long or standard free trials.
Before your first sale
Thinkific has a 30-day free trial[7], Kajabi 14 days[8] and Teachable 7 days.[9]
After your first sale
Thinkific Start $82/month billed annually; Kajabi Basic $143/month billed annually, 0% revenue share; Teachable Starter $29/month billed annually + 7.5%. Prices in US dollars, excluding Indian GST.
Check
Card processing fees and whether your students can pay by UPI.
Best for
Educators testing a course for students outside India.

8. Classplus

Good at
A branded teaching app plus website for coaching businesses; its page says "Get your own brand's teaching app, create your own website & sell courses".
Before your first sale
₹29,999 for 1 year or ₹39,999 for 2 years.[5]
After your first sale
A fee on sales is not stated on the page.
Check
GST, renewal price and whether a trial is offered; none is mentioned on the pricing page.
Best for
An established institute moving online, more than an educator testing a first course.

sections.h2: What your first year costs at small sales
sections.html:
Most new educators sell between a few thousand and a couple of lakh rupees in the first year. The chart adds each published plan price to its published fee at five small sales levels.

{{fig:cost|First-year LMS cost at sales up to ₹2 lakh from published prices: AllCoaching, Exly Starter, Exly with its app add-on, and Classplus|Before GST. The "Exly + app" line adds Exly's mobile app add-on at its lowest listed price, ₹60,000 a year.}} {{cost_table}}

The honest reading: if you only need a checkout page, a no-upfront-fee plan costs least in your first year. On ₹50,000 of sales, Exly Starter costs ₹5,000 against ₹11,999 on AllCoaching Starter, which is about 24% of what you sold. If your sales are that small, that difference matters, and we would rather you knew it.

The order changes when you add your own app or domain. With Exly's app add-on, the same ₹50,000 of sales costs at least ₹65,000. With TagMango Basic plus its ₹24,999-a-year custom-domain setup, it is ₹29,999 + GST. Classplus lists ₹29,999 at any sales level. AllCoaching's ₹11,999 includes your own domain, your own Android app (iOS app on Pro) and unlimited live classes. As sales grow, the gap with Exly Starter narrows; on published prices the two are level at about ₹5 lakh a year.

sections.h2: Which low-cost start fits your situation
sections.html:
You have not made a course yet

Do not pay for anything. Plan one course and record a demo lesson first, then start a free trial when you are ready to build. See how to sell courses online in India.

You teach offline and want to move a batch online

Your students already trust you, so your own website and app are worth more from day one. Our guide on moving offline coaching online shows the order to do it in.

You already have a YouTube or Instagram following

You have demand, so test price, not platform. Sell your first batch quickly, then move to one academy before admin takes over. Read how to get your first 500 students.

You teach on the side of a job

Time is your tightest budget. Choose the option that needs the least setting up and running. See online teaching as a side income.

sections.h2: How to launch your first course with the least risk
sections.html:
The lowest-risk launch tests whether students will pay before you commit money to a year of software.

{{fig:switch|Four steps to launch a first course with little risk: start a free trial, build one course, show it to ten students, choose a plan when ready to sell|Prove demand first. Choose the plan second.}} {{steps}}

When we talk to educators starting out, the ones who do best begin with one narrow course and a free lesson, not a full catalogue.

items: Pick one course you can sell now
One subject, one exam or skill and one result, for example SSC CGL quant in Hindi or 30 days of beginner yoga.
Build on a trial before you pay. AllCoaching gives 7 days with no card; compare the others in the trials table above.
A 10 to 15 minute lesson that shows how you teach is the page students decide on.
Show it to your first students
Share the demo on your YouTube channel, WhatsApp groups and Instagram and ask who would join.
Choose a plan you can carry for a year
Pick the option whose total at a modest first-year sales figure you could pay even if sales are slow.
Confirm you can export student and payment data before you commit to any platform.

faq: What is the cheapest LMS for early-stage educators in India?

On published prices, Exly Starter and TagMango Basic cost the least before your first sale, because they have no upfront fee and take 10% of each sale. If you want your own website and Android app (iOS app on Pro) included, AllCoaching is one annual plan from ₹6,999 plus a fee only when you sell, after a 7-day free trial with no card.
Is there a free LMS for new educators in India?

None of the hosted platforms we checked is free to run long term. You can start free on a trial, use a no-upfront-fee plan that takes 10% of sales, or install the free Tutor LMS core plugin on your own WordPress hosting.
Which LMS has the longest free trial?

Of the platforms we checked on 24 Oct 2026, Thinkific has the longest at 30 days. Kajabi, Circle and Graphy offer 14 days, and AllCoaching, Teachable and Edmingle 7 days. AllCoaching needs no card to start.
Is a no-upfront-fee plan better than an annual plan when starting out?

It costs less at small sales if a checkout page is all you need. If you need your own app or domain, add-ons can make it cost more than an annual plan that includes them, so compare totals with what you need.
Can I run a credible academy on a ₹6,999-a-year plan?

Yes. AllCoaching Starter at ₹6,999 a year plus 10% of sales includes a website on your own domain, your own Android app (iOS app on Pro), unlimited live classes, courses, tests, PDF notes and UPI checkout.
When does an annual plan cost less than a commission-only plan?

It depends on the rates. On published prices, AllCoaching and Exly Starter cost about the same at ₹5 lakh of sales a year, before add-ons. If you need Exly's app add-on, AllCoaching costs less at every sales level.
What is the lowest-risk way to start teaching online?
Make one course with a free demo lesson, build it on a free trial, and show it to ten students on YouTube or WhatsApp before you pay for any plan.
Do I need my own app to start?
No. A mobile-friendly website with UPI checkout is enough for a first batch. An app helps once students return every day for classes and tests.
